purpose: Input for the cross-origin potency rule from verified-pilot-3.14 (config/verified-indices-v3.14.json): the 3.12 rows (Miyoshi 1991 zein LQP, Suetsuna 2000 wakame IY) plus sequence-confirmed purified peptides accepted by the team lead on 2026-10-01 (Lin 2018 Chlorella IW/VW, Kapel 2006 alfalfa VW). potency_replications.verification: Full text read 2026-10-01 (ScienceDirect, Dongguk institutional access). Peptides synthesized by solid phase (433A), HF cleavage, homogeneous on RP-HPLC; Table 2 lists synthetic IC50 values including Ile-Tyr 2.65 uM. Same assay family as Sato 2002 (HHL 12.5 mM, rabbit-lung ACE, 228 nm). Takahisa Nakano (Riken Vitamin) co-authored both this paper and Sato 2002 (10.1021/jf020482t); the values differ (2.65 vs 6.1 uM) and the measuring groups differ (Suetsuna lab vs Tohoku Univ.). Counted as an independent paper by team-lead decision 2026-10-01. pIC50 gap to Sato IY 0.36.

potency_replications.assay: Cushman-Cheung/Wu-Ding: HHL 15 mM in 100 mM borate pH 8.3 with 300 mM NaCl, rabbit-lung ACE (Sigma) 53.2 mU/mL, 37 C 30 min, hippuric acid by RP-HPLC
potency_replications.verification: Full text read 2026-10-01 (Europe PMC, CC BY 4.0). C. sorokiniana hot-water-extract residue hydrolysed with Protease N; Sephadex G-15 fraction F, RP-HPLC peaks re-chromatographed until each was a single component on a C12 column, sequenced by automated Edman degradation (Procise 492); synthetic peptides used only as HPLC standards. The IC50 values (abstract and Results: WV 307.61, VW 0.58, IW 0.50, LW 1.11 uM) are for the purified peptides. Independent group (National Taiwan Ocean University) from Sato 2002. Purified peptide accepted by team-lead decision 2026-10-01.
